title: StorySplat v2.3: Interactive 3D Gaussian Splatting Editor
summary: A web-based platform for creating, hosting, and embedding interactive 3D scenes using Gaussian Splatting technology. It features a PlayCanvas-based engine that supports LOD streaming, dynamic lighting, and first-person navigation within captured environments.
research_notes: Includes proprietary SOG compression to reduce file sizes and supports 4D Gaussian Splatting playback.

evolution.summary: After the v2.0 rebuild on PlayCanvas, the platform introduced SOG compression and LOD streaming. Newer updates in v2.2 and v2.3 added Image-to-Splat generation, 3D measurement tools, and an embeddable NPM viewer, while requiring legacy scenes to be re-exported for compatibility.
